smart_resource_drops.gui.reset_confirm_b:
This will discard all current changes and restore every Resource Multiplier setting to its default value.

Block, entity death-loot, and shearing settings will return to their defaults. Manual shearing returns to ON.

Player-placed block tracking will NOT be affected. Runtime statistics will NOT be affected.

This action cannot be undone.
